objective: Author separate Governance and Ontology Lifecycle Bounded Context and Ubiquitous Language candidates without selecting their cross-context relationship.

selected_inputs.purpose: Admitted canonical meaning of Bounded Context.
Admitted canonical meaning of Ubiquitous Language.
Admitted representation contract for Bounded Context instances.
Admitted representation contract for Ubiquitous Language instances.
Executable structure validation for both artifact kinds.
Admitted separate context and language owner role bindings.
Admission evidence for the two canonical definitions.
Admission evidence for the two artifact types.
Admission evidence for the separate operational owner roles.
Selected Governance source-model identity and posture.
Complete selected Ontology Lifecycle concept, relation, and invariant surface.

four_facet_contract.identity: Each context and language has a stable, versioned, non-overlapping identity and a reciprocal context-language reference.
four_facet_contract.structure: Each context binds one selected domain model and explicit scope; each language binds every selected source concept and its current expression.
four_facet_contract.relationships: Each language binds every selected source relation, while inter-context mappings remain absent until a separate Context Map decision.
four_facet_contract.lifecycle_and_evidence: All four artifacts remain candidate-unadmitted and authority-effect none, carry exact evidence and residue, and expose only generated human projections.

orthogonality_contract: Governance owns authority meaning and decisions; Ontology Lifecycle owns event history, replay, and reconstructed ontology state.
A Governance Event is not a Governance Decision and cannot grant authority.
Ontology Semantic State, Ontology Governance State, and Ontology Lifecycle State are independent axes.
A Context Projection is not a Bounded Context and never becomes canonical ontology truth.
No cross-context term equivalence or relationship pattern is inferred from shared words.
unselected_successors: Exact owner admission decisions for both Bounded Context candidates.
Exact owner admission decisions for both Ubiquitous Language candidates.
A separately authored and selected Governance-to-Ontology-Lifecycle Context Map.
Any migration manifest, source import, implementation binding, runtime enforcement, publication, deployment, or stable release.
claim_ceiling: A passing CTX03 validation proves candidate representation, exact selected-input closure, four-facet coverage, source-surface coverage, owner-role separation, cross-context non-collapse, and projection parity only. It does not admit either context or language, select a Context Map, authorize migration or implementation, publish, deploy, or establish a stable release.
